stories.title: Songs Get Stuck Because of This
stories.description: A weird brain fact about music you can't unhear.

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic close-up of a young person wearing earphones, staring ahead. Minimal head movement, neutral expression. Natural indoor lighting, realistic skin texture, 720p.
scenes.negative_prompt: cartoon, fantasy, exaggerated emotion, text overlay, watermark
scenes.narration: Ever had a song stuck in your head?

scenes.visual_prompt: Abstract non-human visualization of sound waves looping smoothly in a circular motion. Soft glow, calm colors, clean background, slow motion, 720p.
scenes.negative_prompt: numbers, letters, text, chaotic motion, cartoon
scenes.narration: Your brain hates unfinished patterns.

scenes.visual_prompt: Abstract brain-style visualization showing glowing neural paths repeating the same loop. Slow rhythmic motion, dark background, clean scientific aesthetic, 720p.
scenes.negative_prompt: labels, medical diagrams, text, cartoon brain
scenes.narration: So it keeps replaying the song, hoping to finish it.

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic medium close shot of a person slightly smiling as realization hits. Earphones still on. Minimal movement, natural lighting, 720p.
scenes.narration: That’s why it won’t stop.

stories.title: Why You Forget Why You Entered a Room
stories.description: Your brain does this on purpose.

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic shot of a person walking through a doorway and suddenly stopping. Confused body language. Face partially visible. Natural indoor lighting, 720p.
scenes.narration: Ever walk into a room and forget why?

scenes.visual_prompt: Non-human abstract visualization of doors opening and closing smoothly in sequence. Clean minimal design, slow motion, soft glow, 720p.
scenes.narration: Your brain separates spaces.

scenes.visual_prompt: Abstract brain-style visualization showing memory nodes disconnecting and reconnecting. Calm motion, dark background, soft glowing paths, 720p.
scenes.narration: Crossing a doorway can reset what you were thinking.

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic medium shot of a person turning around and walking back slowly. Natural motion, neutral expression, 720p.
scenes.narration: That’s the doorway effect.

stories.title: Why Time Feels Faster at Night

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic close shot of a person checking the time on their phone at night. Blue light reflects on face. Minimal movement, 720p.
scenes.narration: Why does time move faster at night?

scenes.visual_prompt: Non-human abstract visualization of a clock shadow moving faster while light dims. Smooth motion, dark tones, cinematic clarity, 720p.
scenes.narration: Your brain tracks time using events.

scenes.visual_prompt: Abstract visualization of empty timeline segments stretching and compressing. Calm flowing motion, dark background, 720p.
scenes.narration: At night, fewer memories form, so time feels shorter.

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic medium shot of a person realizing the time is late, slight surprise expression. Phone in hand, low light, 720p.
scenes.narration: That’s why hours vanish.

stories.title: Why Your Body Jerks Before Sleep
stories.description: That sudden jump has a reason.

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic shot of a person lying in bed, eyes closing slowly. Calm breathing, minimal motion, low light, 720p.
scenes.narration: Ever feel your body jump before sleep?

scenes.visual_prompt: Non-human abstract visualization of a body outline gently falling through space. Soft motion, dark background, clean design, 720p.
scenes.narration: Your brain thinks you’re falling.

scenes.visual_prompt: Abstract brain-style visualization showing a sudden signal pulse triggering muscle response. Slow controlled animation, dark background, 720p.
scenes.narration: So it sends a signal to wake your body.

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic medium close shot of a person relaxing again in bed, breathing steady. Calm lighting, 720p.
scenes.narration: It’s completely normal.

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic shot of a person sitting alone in a quiet room, slight fidgeting. Neutral expression, natural light, 720p.
scenes.narration: Why does silence feel weird?

scenes.visual_prompt: Non-human abstract visualization of sound waves fading into stillness. Smooth slow motion, dark neutral background, 720p.
scenes.narration: Your brain is always scanning.

scenes.visual_prompt: Abstract visualization showing attention signals increasing in an empty environment. Clean scientific aesthetic, slow motion, 720p.
scenes.narration: Without sound, it searches harder for danger.

scenes.visual_prompt: Realistic medium shot of a person turning on light background noise, then relaxing. Calm posture, 720p.
scenes.narration: That’s why silence feels loud.
